item.description:
### Added - **An agent's latest reply on your iPhone, with a Perch licence.** Tap a session in Perch on iPhone to see the agent's most recent reply. Perch Pro adds the full conversation, live updates and replying from your phone. Needs the latest Perch for iPhone.
### Changed - Settings now explains what Perch Pro adds, and links to Perch on the App Store. - Diagnostics include a short log of "jump to terminal" clicks, to help find out why a click didn't land on the right tab.
